Watery diarrhea progressing
to bloody stools

• Cytotoxin bioassays

• No effective therapy
• Supportive care
-
Dehydration correction
-
Management of electrolyte
abnormalities
-
Blood transfusions as necessary

Environmental inﬂuences
The rapid increase of Crohn’s disease over the past 50 years, increasing trends in immigrant populations, as well as incomplete geno-
type–phenotype associations have promoted attention to environmental factors. In particular, the search to identify an antigenic
trigger to the enteric immune system has been pursued by several investigators. Postulated microbial intraluminal triggers have
